description:
Welcome to Team AeroRehab! We are a specialized team of healthcare professionals and AI software engineers united by a passion for human space exploration, biomechanics, and space medicine.

Our mission is to build an intelligent health monitoring software platform designed to track, analyze, and mitigate microgravity-induced physiological deterioration, specifically focusing on muscle atrophy and progressive bone mineral density (BMD) loss during long-duration space missions.
